content: Ccariɛa d tubbart n iwdan
Munen ɣares Ifarisiyyen d imseřmaden n idlisen i dd-yusin zi Urcalim.
Umi ẓrin belli ca n imeḥḍaren nnes ccin aɣrum břa ggin ad ssirden ifassen nsen d amezwaru, ɛeyyben xasen.
Minzi marra Ifarisiyyen d Wudayen war ttᵉtten mɣir awarni řami ssirden ifassen s yijj n řuḍu mliḥ, minzi tteṭṭfen di tubbart n imɣaren.

U řami dd-usin zi ssuq, war ttᵉtten mařa war ssɣeḍṣen ifassen nsen di tbanyut d amezwaru, u aqa din aṭṭas n tmesřayin nneɣni qebřen tent, maḥend ad zzaysent ṭṭfen ɛlaḥsab tubbart nsen, am useɣḍas n řkisan d teydurin d tebriqin n nnḥas d dduri n řectawat deg ict n tbanyut.
Xenni sseqsan t Ifarisiyyen d imseřmaden n idlisen: “Mayemmi war ḍfaren imeḥḍaren nnec tubbart n imɣaren, maca ttᵉtten aɣrum am war ssiriden ifassen?”
Yarra-dd, inna asen: “Nican inebba Icaɛya xawem, a imnafqen, am mammec tura:
‘Řgens-a iweqqar ayi s iyencicen nnes, maca uř nsen iggʷej xafi!
Maca nitni cennɛen ayi baṭeř, minzi sseřmaden tiɣuriwin tinni d tiweṣṣa n iwdan.’
Minzi tejjim tawṣeyyet n AREBBI, tᵉṭṭfem di tubbart n iwdan, am useɣḍas n řkisan d teydurin deg ict n tbanyut u aṭṭas n tmesřayin nneɣni am tina.”
Inna asen: “Nican aqa tneṭṭařem tawṣeyyet n AREBBI, ḥima ad teqqimem tᵉttᵉṭṭfem di tubbart nwem.
Minzi Musa inna: ‘Weqqar babac d yemmac!’, u: ‘Wenni i ɣa ixzan babas niɣ yemmas, ittxeṣṣa as ad immet.’
Maca kenniw teqqarem: ‘Mařa ijj n weryaz inna i babas niɣ i yemmas: Min ma tzemmarem ad zzayi testenfɛem, aqa ggiɣ t d ṣṣedqet!’,
ammu war t tᵉttejjim qaɛ ad igg ca i babas d yemmas.
Ammu i tesseḥqaram Awař n AREBBI s tubbart nwem i tᵉttsellamem, u tᵉtteggem aṭṭas n tmesřayin am tina.”
Tazdugi n wuř
Iřaɣa-dd Yasuɛ ɣares marra řɣaci, inna asen: “Sřem-dd ɣari marra uca fehmem man aya mliḥ:
War din uřa d ict n řḥajjet i dd-ittadfen ɣar bnadem zi barra tzemmar ad t tessexmej. Maca min i dd-itteffɣen zi bnadem, aqa man aya issexmaj bnadem.
Wenni ɣar ǧan imezzuɣen i useǧi, ejj i-t ad iseř.”
Umi dd-yudef ɣar taddart, iggwej x řɣaci, sseqsan t imeḥḍaren nnes x umedya nni.
Inna asen: “Ma kenniw ɛad břa řefhamet? Ma war tefhimem ca belli marra min ɣa yadfen bnadem zi barra, war izemmar ad t issexmej,
minzi man aya war dd-ittidef ca ɣar wuř nnes, maca ɣar uɛeddis, xenni ad iffeɣ ɣar wemcan nnes, ař ittwassizdeg marra macca.”
Xenni inna: “Min i dd-itteffɣen zi bnadem d man aya issxemmaj bnadem.
Minzi zi daxeř, zeg wuřawen n iwdan i dd-itteffɣen inwayen iɛeffanen: zzina, farq-ccɣeř, tukkarḍa, anɣay,
ṭṭmeɛ, řɣar, taḥraymect, afucceḥ, tiṭṭ taɛeffant, aceqqef, tuffet d tubbuheřya.
Marra timesřayin-a tiɛeffanin tteffɣent-i-dd zi daxeř uca ssxemmajent bnadem.”
L’iman n temɣart di temmurt n Ṣur d Ṣaydun
Ikkar ssenni uca iruḥ ɣar temmurt n weymir n Ṣur d Ṣaydun. Řami dd-yudef ɣar ict n taddart, war ixs ad t issen ḥed, waxxa amenni war izemmar ad innuffar.
Minzi ict n tmeṭṭut, ɣares yeǧis dayes ijj n řaryaḥ d amengus, tesřa xas deɣya. Nettat tusa-dd ɣares, tewḍa as ɣar iḍaren nnes.
Tuɣa tamɣart-a d ict n temɣart takafriwt zi temmurt n Finiqiya nni tuɣa d tasɣart n Suriya. Nettat tzawg i-t maḥend ad issuffeɣ cciṭan zeg yeǧis.
Maca Yasuɛ inna as: “Ejj iḥenjiren amezwar ad jjiwnen, minzi war ittřiq ad ittwakkes weɣrum n iḥenjiren ḥima ad immenḍar i yiṭan.”
Maca nettat tarra-dd, tenna as: “Wah, a Sidi, uřa d iṭan ttᵉtten iřeqqʷaz n iḥenjiren sadu ṭṭabřa.”
Inna as Yasuɛ: “Uyur, minzi x ssibbet n wawař-a i tennid, aqa iffeɣ cciṭan zeg yeǧim.”
Řami dd-tusa ɣar taddart nnes, tufa yeǧis tezzeř di qama u cciṭan ittwassuffeɣ zzayes.
Asgenfi n ijj n udehcur
Iffeɣ-dd Yasuɛ ɛawed zi temmurt n Ṣur d Ṣaydun, yiweḍ ɣar řebḥar n Ljalil ɣar ṭṭarf n temmurt n Dikapulis.
Iwyen-dd ɣares ijj n udehcur, itewtaw, uca ttaren zzayes ad xas issars afus nnes.
Issiggʷej i-t zi řɣaci ɣar uɣezdis uca igga as iḍewḍan deg imezzuɣen nnes, issusef uca iḥada iřes nnes.
Xenni ixzar ɣar ujenna, izehhar, inna as: “Nurzem!”
Řexdenni nnurzmen imezzuɣen nnes uca tefsi tesɣunt n yiřes nnes, ibda issawař nican.
Iɛřem asen war t qqaren i ḥed, maca mecḥař ma ten yumur, waxxa amenni tuɣa ssuffuɣen xas řexbar mahu.
Uca tbehten s unexřiɛ ařami nnan: “Marra igga i-t mliḥ! Yarra idehcar ttesřan d ignawen ssawařen.”
